subject: Money
title: Bitcoin's Wild Ride
description: A quick, practical guide to Bitcoin's Wild Ride.

buildup.text: Bitcoin started as a peer-to-peer payment experiment. It became digital gold, then a speculative asset.

discovery.text: Bitcoin has no earnings, no dividends, no cash flow. Its value is whatever the next buyer will pay.

twist.text: Each crash was called the death of Bitcoin. Each recovery proved skeptics wrong—until the next crash.

climax.text: Is Bitcoin a bubble or a new asset class? After 15 years, the debate is as alive as the price volatility.

punchline.text: Either it's the future. Or the biggest bubble ever.

quiz.question: What makes Bitcoin difficult to value?
options: It has no earnings, dividends, or cash flow
It's controlled by a single company
